Factual.content: The comment presents only two mutually exclusive outcomes—either the Cubans succeed in overthrowing the socialist government or they will endure the current conditions forever—implicitly excluding any other possible scenarios such as political reform, international assistance, or incremental change. This narrow framing of the situation as a strict either/or choice is a classic example of a false dilemma. The comment does not substantiate the claim that only these two outcomes are feasible, nor does it acknowledge alternative pathways, thereby committing the false dilemma fallacy.
